Job Objective

We are a leading technology hub in Guangzhou, dedicated to innovation and excellence in the tech industry. We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated risk manager role with focus mainly on operational risk to strengthen DTC’s overall risk control resiliency. This role is pivotal in establishing, maintaining, and enhancing DTC’s operational risk framework, as well as ensuring stringent compliance with internal policies, processes and external regulations and providing continuous guidance and support to BU/SU on Risk/ LCS subjects.

Principal Responsibilities

Assist in establishing, maintaining, and enhancing DTC’s operational risk framework, including but not limited to:

  • Responsible for implementation of corporate operational risk PSG within the unit.
  • Responsible for development and implementation of unit-specific operational risk PSG and procedures.
  • Review proposed deviations from corporate and unit-specific operational risk policies and standards and residual risk rating.
  • Analyse and identify emerging trends and potential operational risks, including tracking and management reporting, e.g. Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA), Key Risk Indicator (KRI), pre-audit assessment.
  • Run regular unit risk forum and attend group-level risk forum where required.
  • Oversee Business Continuity Management (BCM) and incident management.
  • Manage operational risk initiatives and target reviews.
  • Proactive in forging effective engagement with key stakeholders on overall risk management and governance matters.
  • Design and implement operational risk measures as part of DTC’s operational risk monitoring process.
  • Review and update relevant policies/ standards/ procedures.
  • Promote staff awareness, follow and track compulsory trainings and consequence management.
  • Other risk management related work as assigned by manager.

This role would also provide certain support to LCS (Legal, Compliance & Secretariat) function where needed, including but not limited to:

  • Identify, advise and manage legal/ regulatory risks associated with the operation of business and other related matters.
  • Update relevant policies/ standards/ procedures/ documentations where needed.

Other LCS related work as assigned by manager.

Education And Relevant Experience

  • Full-time bachelor degree holder (with law or risk management related major being a plus); master degree is preferred.
  • Minimum 8-year experience in legal/ compliance or risk management domain.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in identifying, assessing, treating, monitoring, reporting, and advising on corporate risk management.
  • Excellent organizational, problem solving, interpersonal and operating skills to independently and effectively drive tasks.
  • Experience in technology industry is an advantage.

Functional / Technical Competencies

  • Strong written and oral communication skills (in both English and Chinese), analytical and solution-oriented.
  • Profound knowledge of operational risk management requirements of China, in particular those applicable to IT business.
  • Knowledge and experience in technology company operational risk management practice is an advantage.
  • Strong ability to prioritize, self-motivated, independent and able to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willing to learn and take new challenges with an open-mind.
  • Good inter-personal skills, good commercial sense and a team player.

Location:

Guangzhou (DTC)

Job:

Risk Management

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Digital Product Manager.

Business: Digital Platforms

Red ID：53870

Location: Guangzhou, TKH

Principal Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain the multi-year DIVA product vision and roadmap aligned to business outcomes and market needs (e.g., account onboarding, mobile setup, servicing, step-up verification).
  • Lead ideation with cross-functional stakeholders to shape opportunities into prioritized initiatives, and translate them into clear business cases (problem statement, options, costs, benefits, risks, and success metrics)
  • Translate business cases into prioritized capabilities/epics/features with clear value cases, success metrics, and delivery milestones.
  • Identify opportunities to scale DIVA across markets and business lines; drive standardization aimed to improve speed and control.
  • Optimize end-to-end verification journeys to improve completion and pass rates while minimizing friction.
  • Use data (funnel analytics, error codes, VOC) to diagnose drop-offs and drive iterative improvements (e.g., retries, step-up flows, guided capture).
  • Lead cross-functional squads (engineering, UX, data, QA) to deliver outcomes using agile practices.
  • Own product requirements (PRDs/user stories), acceptance criteria, and release readiness.
  • Manage dependencies across platforms (mobile/web), downstream consuming journeys etc
  • Ensure DIVA capabilities meet security, privacy, and regulatory requirements; partner closely with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Model Risk as applicable.

Requirements

  • Experience as a Digital Product Manager/Owner delivering customer-facing products at scale.
  • Strong understanding of digital identity verification, authentication, or fraud/risk controls in financial services (or similarly regulated industries).
  • Proven ability to use data to drive product decisions (funnels, conversion, operational metrics).
  • Experience leading cross-functional delivery teams and managing complex stakeholder landscapes.
  • Strong written communication: ability to produce crisp product requirement materials, decision papers, and governance updates.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website./WX

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Software Engineering Manager.

Business: Asia & Middle East Technology

Job ID: 55771

Principal Responsibilities

  • Pod Lead Delegate / delivery leadership: drive day-to-day execution, run ceremonies where needed, manage RAID, and keep scope-plan-outcomes aligned.
  • Own end-to-end delivery across SDLC: design, build, test, release, hypercare, and continuous improvement.
  • Build scalable ELT on BigQuery + dbt: modelling, incremental patterns, optimisation, and cost/performance tuning.
  • Develop and review Python for data processing, automation, validation, and operational tooling (production-quality code).
  • Enable BI outcomes using Apache Superset: support dataset modelling for analytics use, define governed metrics where applicable, and ensure dashboards are performant, trusted, and maintainable.
  • Implement strong data quality and reconciliation controls: rule-based checks, anomaly detection patterns, and clear remediation workflows.
  • Embed NFRs and controls by design: security, access, auditability, lineage, monitoring/alerting, resilience, and operational readiness (runbooks).
  • Drive engineering excellence: code reviews, reusable dbt macros/patterns, standards for testing (dbt tests + Python), and release discipline.
  • Leverage GenAI-enabled delivery responsibly: improve documentation quality, accelerate analysis and test creation, and streamline incident triage—while ensuring human review, data confidentiality, and secure usage.
  • Partner with Architecture/Platform/Security/Controls to align with enterprise standards and governance.
  • People leadership: hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, performance management, and career development in an inclusive way.
  • Communicate clearly in English (and collaborate effectively with local stakeholders; Cantonese preferred): design docs, decision papers, status updates, and stakeholder comms.

Requirements

  • Lead end-to-end ETL delivery: requirements, design, build, test, release and production support
  • Strong RDBMS/SQL capability: complex SQL, data analysis, performance tuning and troubleshooting
  • Hands-on Python for data processing and automation (clean, maintainable, production-ready code)
  • Experience enabling analytics/BI delivery, ideally with Apache Superset (dashboards, datasets, performance tuning, stakeholder iteration).
  • Confident in Linux & Shell scripting for job automation, scheduling and incident diagnosis
  • Demonstrated technical ownership: able to work independently, drive decisions and manage delivery risks
  • Proven people leadership: plan work, delegate effectively, coach team members and manage performance

/WX/LP

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. ln:4451378969.descriptionHtml:
About The Opportunity

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 31 December 2026

Job Description

Title SI Solutions - FIC Proxy Voting Analyst

Department Asset Management CAO

Location Dalian

Level: 2

About Fidelity International

Fidelity International offers world class investment solutions and retirement expertise. As a privately owned, independent company, investment is our only business. We are driven by the needs of our clients, not by shareholders. Our vision is to deliver innovative client solutions for a better future.

Our people are passionate, engaged, smart and curious, and we give them the independence and the confidence to make a difference. While we take pride in the excellence of our investment solutions and client service, we know we can always do better. We are honest, respectful and make tough calls, challenging the status quo to achieve better outcomes through innovation. Above all else, we always put our clients first.

About Fidelity Dalian

Established in 2007, FIL Technology (Dalian) Limited was the Fidelity’s first wholly owned enterprise in China. The Dalian office initially served as a systems development centre to bolster Fidelity’s growing business in the Asia Pacific region, with a primary focus on providing technology and web-based support and services. The office has continued to expand in recent years and now acts as the central service hub for the Asia Pacific region supporting multiple business functions including systems development and support, systems infrastructure support, retail operations, finance accounting services and investment administration & fund accounting.

Team Description

Asset Management CAO team is responsible front to back, for the operational and supporting capabilities across investment management. The Investment Management Solutions team is a cross asset delivery & support function driving collaboration, consistency & execution across the global asset management platform. The team drives strategic initiatives, provide support services enabling our investment team, and partners with our investment leaders to strengthen oversight, risk controls & regional regulatory engagement. Within the IM Solutions function the Sustainable Investing Solutions team is responsible for supporting global FIL’s proxy voting activities as well as core governance & reporting activates underpinning FIL’s sustainable investment approach.

About Your Role

As the SI Solutions - Analyst, you will play a key role in supporting the firm’s stewardship activities. Your responsibilities will include analyzing shareholder meeting agendas, providing insightful voting recommendations, and executing high‑quality, timely proxy votes in alignment with the firm’s policies and fiduciary duties. You will also contribute to policy development and ongoing process improvements. In this role, you will collaborate closely with investment teams, Sustainable Investing analysts, and proxy service providers to strengthen the firm’s governance framework and enhance our stewardship outcomes.

About You

The successful candidate will be a detail‑oriented governance professional with demonstrated expertise in applying in‑house voting policies and conducting precise research on investee AGM/EGM agendas. This role requires performing accurate analysis in complex or non‑standard voting scenarios and consistently delivering timely, high‑quality voting instructions. With a growing understanding of Sustainable Investing functions, the candidate is expected to operate with strong process discipline, overseeing end‑to‑end vote execution, quality assurance, and pipeline management. As the global regulations related to Sustainable Investing continue to evolve rapidly, the candidate must be able to learn, adapt, and refine deliverables to meet emerging requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze FIL Investee companies’ global shareholder meeting agendas, focusing on complex corporate governance, remuneration, and ESG related proposals.
  • Conduct researches and FIL voting policy application by leveraging FIL’s research capabilities, in-house voting policy, and external research resources to make thorough and informed voting recommendations for Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team.
  • Assist Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team in engagement activities with investee companies on governance and sustainability topics.
  • Handle end-to-end vote execution processes to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance. Provide non-standard voting support to address specific client requirements.
  • Coordinate with external proxy advisors, custodians, and voting platforms to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
  • Contribute to periodic reviews and updates of proxy voting policies and procedures. Monitor regulatory and market developments in governance, stewardship, and ESG.
  • Support the preparation of stewardship reports, respond to client inquiries, and complete regulatory disclosures.
  • Support the implementation of new voting strategies and practices, and identify, drive and contribute to continuous process improvementation.
  • Develop & maintain consolidated, auditable process documentation library.

Experience And Qualifications Required

  • Education in Finance, Business, Economics, Sustainability Investment or related field. Master degree is preferred.
  • Experience in researches and analysis in proxy voting, corporate governance, stewardship, ESG or Sustainable Investing is a strong plus.
  • Strong analytical and research skills with the ability to interpret corporate filings and governance documents.
  • Analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and excellent attention to detail and accuracy in a high volume, deadline driven environment.
  • Data analytical and automation skills (Python/SQL/PowerBI), experience of developing automation for business processes is highly preferred. Experience as Project Manager, Business Analyst, SME is a strong plus.
  • Proficient in using AI tools to improve efficiency, ensure accuracy, and solve business problems.
  • Highly efficient English communication skills, both written and verbal is mandatory.
  • Demonstrated learning ability and interest in Investment knowledge. CFA, FRM related certificate is highly preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, and highly developed teamwork skills
  • Global stakeholder management and global collaboration model experience is required. Proven record to manage stakeholder and deliver high quality work under pressure.
  • A good team player with open-minded, flexible and positive attitude for changes.
  • Self-disciplined and self-motivated to drive business result with a clear career plan.

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.
